methodology: Preliminary screening using Qur'anic narrative and candidate Exodus locators. Not a collation of critical MT/LXX editions or dated witnesses. Each proposed link is unverified and nonpublic. Checked previous PR #269 and unresolved security PR #93; source verification and authoritative ledger reconciliation pending. No claim of textual dependence.

records.topic: Prosperity and adversity attributed to Moses as an omen
records.notes: Egyptian responses to plagues are narrated in Exodus, but the explicit good-fortune-as-deserved and bad-omen-blaming-Moses contrast is not the same dialogue.
records.pending_question: Compare Arabic ṭāʾir and relevant biblical omen language; check whether any pre-Islamic narrative attributes ill omen to Moses.

records.topic: Pharaoh's people reject every sign in advance
records.notes: Exodus describes Pharaoh's hardened heart and refusal to heed signs, but not this precise blanket statement to Moses.
records.pending_question: Check differences between divine hardening and speakers' declared refusal in MT and LXX.

records.topic: Flood, locusts, vermin, frogs, and blood as distinct signs
records.notes: Shared named calamities include blood, frogs, lice/gnats and locusts; Exodus has a longer ordered plague sequence and does not clearly equate Qur'anic ṭūfān with one of its plagues.
records.pending_question: Collate Arabic al-qummal and al-ṭūfān with Hebrew kinnim and relevant Greek; avoid asserting identical species or flood event.

records.topic: Afflicted Egyptians ask Moses to pray for relief and promise belief and release
records.notes: Exodus repeatedly has Pharaoh request Moses' intercession and promise concessions; the Qur'anic collective speech includes belief and release, and cannot be treated as verbatim Exodus dialogue.
records.pending_question: Check each plague's speaker and promise separately; compare MT/LXX wording and transmission.

records.topic: Relief granted for a term followed by broken promises
records.notes: Both narratives describe renewed refusal after respite, but the Qur'anic appointed term and collective attribution differ from the Exodus scenes.
records.pending_question: Examine time-limit expression and whether the comparison is an episode-level parallel or a composite of multiple Exodus episodes.

pending_questions: Verify primary passages in identified Hebrew and Greek editions, recording exact version and witness dates.
